==Description==
'''M-70''' is the fourth entity you will encounter within [[Section M]]. It was added in the third Restructured update test and it is a more diverse, unique entity compared to others. More information about '''M-70''' will be presented below.

==Mechanic==
When M-70 spawns, the doors behind you will all close. After a bit the next doors label will ping a couple of times, M-70 will then appear behind the door and backtrack though the rooms. If a player exits their hiding spot, M-70 will come back for them. After 10-15 seconds, M-70 will despawn. If M-70 catches a player not being fully hidden, they will instantly die.  

However, there's a chance for M-70 to ambush player by playing a weird music-like sound, not closing any doors behind. M-70 still blocks the next door from opening. If you hear a faint music - it's best to hide.   

== Note ==
'''M-70''' sometimes doesn't close the doors and instead play its jumpscare sound's initial beeps, so pay attention for this.

== Strategy & Tips ==

* '''M-70''' might wait for [[M-60]] to finish checking the locker before fallbacking, so when [[M-60]] despawns wait a few seconds in the locker to avoid getting killed by '''M-70'''.
* '''M-70''' sometimes doesn't close the doors and instead play its Jumpscare sound's initial beeps, so pay attention for this.
* '''M-70'''<nowiki/>'s snipe is instakill, so if needed, slam-enter in the locker if you're going to die by '''M-70''', but that's risky because of [[M-134]].

==Trivia==
* '''M-70''' now can ambush the player as with the most recent update, it will not close the doors and instead will make a weird beep sound, as it will backtrack silently with whispers.
* Using tables as hiding spot against '''M-70''' is bad idea, as it will still aim at you just like if you aren't hiding.
* '''M-70''' can spawn alongside with locker checker entities like [[M-150]], or [[M-200]].
